evidence_class: PRE-REGISTRATION (hypotheses only; none of these five run in Session 7; no slot used)
scope_note: Ranked, untried fault-zone-anatomy-lane hypotheses for the NEXT separately budgeted session. Excluded because already tested in this repository: H57-H bend/scarp strike, H57-I2 two-host relay, H57-J slip-sense transition, sin2d/cos2d interactions (H57-D negative), the dot-budget sweep, and H6-1 catalogue-proximity pruning (tested in Session 7, evidence/session7_h61_prune.json). H6-2/H6-3 below were pre-registered in Session 6 and never run. All quantities must be labelled HOLDOUT-DTI (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, withheld positives, 95% CI) or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED; projections are never scores.
validation_rule: Test only the top-ranked candidate in the next budget. Spatially blocked hide-and-recover holdout (buffered whole-component LOQO, 153 physical 20 km clusters, paired draws). Retain only on a strictly positive paired 95% lower bound against the matched control. Reject on any feature-alone canary AUC > 0.90 or any cross-lane uniqueness firing. No weekly slot on any result that has not cleared both.
target_note: The scored target is geological fault presence (new fault pixels not already in USGS/INGENIOUS), not geothermal-vent or reservoir labels. Fault-permeability pathways are exploration evidence only.

ranked.hypothesis: Fault-tip termination and splay-root anatomy: the signed along-strike distance to visible component tips, and the fan of damage around them, adds held-out skill beyond distance-to-fault and two-host relay geometry.
layers: band 3 tmi_hg and band 6 tc (magnetic edge continuation across a tip)
ranked.physical_signature: Signed tip-distance transform along the host strike; magnetic tilt-edge continuity that steps past a mapped termination (a splay root) rather than dying with it.
ranked.why_new_faults_not_catalogued: Organizer thread 11536 makes newly mapped geometry of an existing system count as new fault; growth fronts live at fault tips and relays, while the through-going interior of a mapped trace is already captured pixel-exactly by USGS/INGENIOUS and earns nothing.
ranked.differs_from_repo: None of the 22 current anatomy/relay/bend features contains an endpoint-distance term; REMAINING_WORK named H57-B (tip-lobe) the cheapest untried anatomy hypothesis. H6-2 was pre-registered but never executed.
ranked.implementation_cost: low (visible-only EDTs and endpoint extraction; 2-4 new columns)
ranked.falsifier: Paired 95% lower bound vs relay_bend_anatomy is at or below zero; or skill concentrates on one side of the fault only; or any canary exceeds 0.90.

ranked.hypothesis: Stepover dilatation sign: releasing (transtensional pull-apart) relay corridors between left-stepping dextral hosts carry higher secondary-strand intensity than restraining ones, measurable from detrended topography and isostatic-gravity gradients without any textbook angle.
layers: band 12 det_elev and band 19 det_elev_slope (corridor subsidence and flank scarps)
band 13 iso_grav_anom and band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope (low-density basin fill)
existing relay_facing / relay_ratio features as the frame
ranked.physical_signature: Signed cross-corridor profile of (detrended elevation x gravity anomaly) conditioned on relay_facing: negative gravity low centered in the stepover with flanking scarp slopes.
ranked.why_new_faults_not_catalogued: Pull-apart basins between left-stepping dextral faults (Faulds, Henry and Hinz, northern Walker Lane) are the youngest, most distributed strand habitat and are systematically under-mapped relative to through-going traces.
ranked.differs_from_repo: relay_ratio and relay_facing encode corridor geometry but not the sign of extension; E3 tested slip-sense transitions, not stepover dilatation. No gravity-topography cross-profile exists in the 22 features.
ranked.implementation_cost: medium (cross-corridor profile sampling in the two-host frame; 3-5 columns)
ranked.falsifier: No paired gain over relay_bend_anatomy; or the effect flips under a matched restraining-bend control; canary AUC > 0.90 on any new column.

ranked.hypothesis: Geodetic strain-rate concordance: secondary-strand probability rises where the damage-zone intensity coincides with an anomaly in geodetic shear-rate / second invariant, because the catalogue misses young active strands and geodesy is catalogue-independent.
layers: band 7 geod_shearrate, band 4 geod_2ndinv, band 8 geod_dilaterate
band 10 deq_n100a15 and band 16 ieq_n100a15 (seismicity context)
fitted damage-zone intensity from the retained lane features
ranked.physical_signature: Local (1-3 km) z-score of geodetic shear rate interacting multiplicatively with the fitted anatomy intensity; not a flat per-band rank.
ranked.why_new_faults_not_catalogued: Compiled maps lag young displacement; strain localization marks strands whose slip postdates the compilation, which is exactly the hidden population the organizer scores (thread 11536).
ranked.differs_from_repo: H57-K fed all 19 bands as flat q/z ranks into one GBM (a negative live result, 0.0106 at 62,872 dots, OWNER-REPORTED); the targeted strain-rate x anatomy interaction was never isolated on the buffered LOQO instrument.
ranked.implementation_cost: low-medium (band caches already local; interaction columns only)
ranked.falsifier: Interaction column alone fires the canary (seismicity/distance confound); or paired gain is at or below zero; or the gain survives removal of seismicity bands only via the distance term (rank-redundancy ablation).

ranked.hypothesis: Flight-line-aligned magnetic-mimic suppression: magnetic-gradient lineaments parallel to survey flight-line direction and unmatched by a gravity or scarp edge are leveling artifacts, and down-weighting them improves held-out precision over the unsuppressed magnetic-edge feature.
layers: band 1 mag_anom, band 2 rtp, band 14 tmi, band 9 tmi_vg (magnetic family)
band 13 iso_grav_anom, band 12 det_elev (independent edge corroboration)
flight-line azimuth from GeoDAWN survey metadata (USGS/GDR official pages) or a stripe-periodicity estimator on band 3 tmi_hg
ranked.physical_signature: Stripe-parallel anisotropy in tmi_hg without a matching gravity/scarp edge; suppression weight = 1 - |cos(2*(theta_edge - theta_flightline))| * (1 - corroboration).
ranked.why_new_faults_not_catalogued: It is a precision-side feature: alpha=0.2 FP cost means a mimic removed is worth up to five times a marginal hit; the 0.2778 winner is itself a precision-side construction (dots removed, nothing added).
ranked.differs_from_repo: No stripe-filtered or flight-line-aware magnetic feature exists in this repository; 17GEMSDOE E-proba-multiscale is a dense surface lane, not mimic suppression.
ranked.implementation_cost: medium (flight-line azimuth from official metadata text pages or an internal FFT/structure-tensor stripe estimator; no new raster required)
ranked.new_external_data_required: Official survey flight-line metadata: USGS GeoDAWN data-series landing page https://www.usgs.gov/data/geodawn-airborne-magnetic-and-radiometric-surveys-northwestern-great-basin-nevada-and (DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ) and GDR/INGENIOUS https://gbcge.org/current-projects/ingenious/ ; both are free official text pages reachable for manual review. If binary grid downloads stay egress-blocked, the stripe-azimuth estimator keeps the hypothesis viable with zero external binaries.
ranked.falsifier: Suppression removes true-fault signal (withheld recall drops more than precision gains); or the paired lower bound is at or below zero; or the estimated stripe azimuth is not stable across 20 km blocks.

ranked.hypothesis: Radiometric K/eTh alteration-halo concordance: potassic-alteration ratios adjacent to stepover damage zones corroborate permeable Quaternary strand habitat and improve precision over the anatomy intensity alone.
layers: GeoDAWN radiometric grids (K, eTh, eU) from ScienceBase DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ
bridged auxiliary raster GEMSDOE40:data/aux/radiometric_u8.tif in the public owner inventory (obtainable through the allowed github.com host; provenance UNVERIFIED until pinned and profiled)
retained relay/bend damage-zone intensity as the conditioning frame
ranked.physical_signature: K/Th ratio high (potassic micas in hydrothermal alteration) bounded by, not centered on, the mapped trace; intersection with relay corridors.
ranked.why_new_faults_not_catalogued: Alteration halos mark long-lived permeable structures whose surface trace may be too subtle for compiled maps; used as corroboration it sharpens allocation precision.
ranked.differs_from_repo: Unused in every variant of this repository; sibling r11f-scarp-radiometric-fusion (0.1589, OWNER-REPORTED) underperformed standalone lidarscarp-ridge (0.1461), which is prior evidence that naive fusion can dilute a strong single-evidence ranking.
ranked.implementation_cost: higher (data acquisition, provenance authentication, ratio construction, NODATA screening)
ranked.new_external_data_required: USGS GeoDAWN radiometric grids, ScienceBase DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ (official, free). Checked obtainable: the GeoDAWN landing page is live and the repository inventory shows a bridged radiometric raster (GEMSDOE40:data/aux/radiometric_u8.tif) fetchable via the github.com API; full-fidelity grids would need ScienceBase binary download from an unrestricted machine or a hash-pinned bridge part.
ranked.falsifier: No paired gain once K/Th is added to the anatomy arm; or the ratio tracks lithologic units (diorite vs basalt) rather than strand proximity in a lithology-stratified check.

named_non_fault_mimics_across_candidates: erosional range-front and fluvial-terrace scarps (topography and detrended-elevation terms)
lithologic contacts and mafic dike swarms (magnetic and gravity-gradient edges)
flight-line leveling residuals and variable terrain clearance (magnetic stripe artifacts)
alluvial-basin edges and sediment thickness contrasts (gravity low, conductivity contrast)
catalogue digitization vertices and map-sheet seams (trace geometry)
